c64_segments.method: from the case's routine to the CHANG2 resume LOC after it (that routine outside the KEEP mask), against yaAGC stopped at NEWOPS with LOC there (IRC_SNAPROW); each equal to the oracle on the host with the same mask

outcome_cover.method: clang -fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard edges (each branch outcome) over every linked source but the test harness, per case (tools/irc_edges.c)

boundary: from each routine entry state to NEWOPS with LOC outside the file, an exit of the interpreter bodies (lm: POODOO1, ALARM1; cm: POODOO, ALARM), or a transfer to an outside basic routine (cm: 2PHSCHNG, BAILOUT, BANKCALL, BANKJUMP, BLANKET, BZF, CHANG2, DOWNFLAG, ENDOFJOB, FALTON, FINDVAC, GENTRAN, GOTOPOOH, MAKECADR, NOVAC, PHASCHNG, POSTJUMP, PRIOCHNG, TCF ENDEXT, TCF SUPDXCHZ, TRFAILOF, TRFAILON, UPFLAG)
compared: Z, 2048 erasable words (A, L 16-bit) and the interrupt-enable state
